title: Build a Personal Portfolio Page
description: Create a responsive personal portfolio page using HTML and CSS. Must include: navigation, hero section, projects grid, and contact form. Use semantic HTML elements throughout.

title: JavaScript DOM Manipulation Quiz
description: 15 questions covering DOM selection, event handling, element creation, and attribute manipulation. Open book, 45-minute time limit.

title: Generic Type Challenges
description: Implement a set of generic utility types from scratch: DeepPartial, DeepReadonly, TupleToUnion, and ChainedValidator. Must pass all provided test cases.

title: Design an E-Commerce Database Schema
description: Design a normalized database schema for an e-commerce platform. Include: users, products, orders, payments, and reviews. Provide an ER diagram and SQL DDL statements.

title: SQL Query Optimization Lab
description: Given a set of slow queries, use EXPLAIN ANALYZE to identify bottlenecks. Create appropriate indexes and rewrite queries to improve performance by at least 10x.

title: Build a Task Manager App
description: Create a full-featured task manager using React with Zustand for state management. Include: CRUD operations, drag-and-drop sorting, filtering, and local storage persistence.

title: React Hooks Discussion
description: Share your experience using React hooks. What custom hooks have you built? What patterns do you find most useful? Respond to at least two classmates.

title: Conditional Types Quiz
description: 20 questions on conditional types, infer keyword, distributive conditional types, and type narrowing. Closed book, 30-minute time limit.
